correctness.rationale: An invariant geometric simplex has barycentric coordinates constant on edge orbits. Usable edge orbits must be perfect cross-cycle matchings between equal-length vertex cycles, or single antipodal pairings within even cycles. This proves the exact join model. Explicit face counting yields the polynomial. The order-preserving forgetful map to pair-block matchings has Boolean fibers; toggling the least unoccupied singleton gives an acyclic matching by the cluster lemma. Critical cells are exactly phase-labelled perfect pair-block matchings, proving the all-even integral homotopy formula. Standalone exact finite checks independently confirmed 19 cycle types, 15 component homology cases, and 3366 acyclic face-poset nodes.

value.rationale: Geometric symmetry-fixed subspaces of ordinary matching complexes are natural and substantially richer than nonequivariant Betti numbers. The proof gives a complete cycle-index model for all permutations, exact integral homotopy for all even-cycle types, contractibility whenever any even-cycle length has odd multiplicity, and infinite new noninvolutive cases such as 4^2 and 4^2 6^2. This is a structural classification with explicit mathematical use, not an isolated calculation or simple rephrasing of the already known involution case.
